countries.reasoning: Based on USGS 2024 PTFE production report, China’s PTFE output estimates ~152,000 mt in 2023 and dominates the global market. Confidence is high due to recent authoritative data, though coating-specific figures may be slightly lower.

USGS 2024 data shows US PTFE production ~76,000 mt; major U.S. manufacturers (Chemours, DuPont) confirm this level. Confidence is good but slightly lower because coating use is a subset of total PTFE.
Japanese PTFE output ~57,000 mt per USGS 2024; primary producers (JSR, Sumitomo) report similar volumes. Confidence moderate due to potential under-reporting of coating-specific production.
Korean PTFE production ~38,000 mt estimated from 2023 industry reports and USGS 2024 totals. Confidence moderate as data may not distinguish coating-specific use.
German PTFE output ~19,000 mt based on European market analysis (Eurostat, 2023). Confidence lower because detailed coating production shares are not publicly disclosed.
